---
title: "Sixty years of space launches"
output: html_document
---

This is an R Markdown document, the older sibling of Quarto. Chunks run
the same way, and Render makes the finished page.

Every launch toward orbit from 1957 to 2018, from Jonathan McDowell's
launch vehicle database, as prepared by *The Economist*.

```{r}
launches <- read.csv("data/launches.csv")
table(launches$outcome)
```

Who launches has changed. Until the 1990s almost every launch was a
government's. Companies came later, then start ups.

```{r}
per_year <- table(launches$agency_type, launches$year)
barplot(per_year, col = c("#C8601F", "#3A8F5C", "#1F5F8B"), border = NA, las = 2,
        cex.names = 0.6, legend.text = c("Private", "Start up", "State"),
        args.legend = list(x = "topright", bty = "n"), ylab = "Launches")
```

Launches have also become far more reliable. The share that failed, in
percent, by decade:

```{r}
launches$decade <- floor(launches$year / 10) * 10
round(100 * prop.table(table(launches$decade, launches$outcome), 1)[, "failure"], 1)
```
